sites.name: Lung Cu Flag Tower
sites.event: A sacred symbol of national sovereignty at the northernmost point of the Fatherland, associated with the legend of King Quang Trung placing bronze drums.

sites.name: Vuong Family Mansion (Meo King's Palace)
sites.event: The grand mansion of 'Meo King' Vuong Chinh Duc, a unique architectural work combining H'Mong, Chinese, and French cultures.

sites.name: Ma Pi Leng Pass
sites.event: One of Vietnam's 'Four Great Passes', located on the legendary 'Happiness Road' built by tens of thousands of youth volunteers.

place.commune: Pa Vi Commune, Pai Lung Commune

sites.name: Dong Van Karst Plateau
sites.event: A UNESCO Global Geopark, preserving traces of the Earth's crust development history and unique local culture.

place.district: Quan Ba District, Yen Minh District, Dong Van District, Meo Vac District

sites.name: Hoang Su Phi Terraced Fields
sites.event: A National Scenic Monument, a masterpiece of wet rice cultivation on steep terrain by the Dao, Nung, and La Chi people.

place.commune: Ban Phung, Ban Luoc, San Sa Ho, Ho Thau Communes...

sites.name: Nho Que River (Tu San Canyon)
sites.event: Home to Tu San Canyon - the deepest canyon in Southeast Asia, located at the foot of Ma Pi Leng Pass.

place.commune: Giang Chu Phin Commune, Pa Vi Commune

sites.name: Dong Van Old Quarter
sites.event: A century-old ancient town with earthen-walled architecture and yin-yang tiled roofs, a place of trade and residence for the Tay, H'Mong, and Hoa ethnic groups.

sites.name: Quan Ba Twin Mountains (Fairy Mountain)
sites.event: Associated with the legend of the fairy Hoa Dao leaving her breast milk to raise her child, creating two uniquely shaped mountains.

sites.name: Bac Me Prison Relic
sites.event: A prison built by French colonialists (1938-1942) to detain revolutionary soldiers.

sites.name: Tham Ma Slope
sites.event: A famous winding pass road, legend has it that in the past, people tested horses here (pack horses that reached the top still strong were kept).

sites.name: Milestone No. 0 (Km0)
sites.event: The starting point of the 'Happiness Road', marking the journey to conquer the karst plateau.

sites.name: Khau Vai Love Market
sites.event: A unique market held once a year (on the 27th day of the 3rd lunar month), where lovers who could not be together return to meet.
